summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement reducing the dollar amount of common stock sellable under its at-the-market issuance sales agreement with WallachBeth Capital to zero. The move reflects a capacity constraint under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, which caps sales at one-third of non-affiliate float within 12 months. Because the aggregate market value of non-affiliate-held shares (~$17.7 million as of the pricing date) remains below $75 million, the company's remaining capacity is exhausted after $1.8 million sold in the trailing year. No shares were sold in this filing.
